title: Jamaican Fluffy Bowl with Roasted Asparagus
description: A flavorful Jamaican-inspired bowl filled with fluffy rice, roasted asparagus, and a hint of tropical spices.
instructions: Trim the asparagus and place on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with kissed (olive oil) and sprinkle with Jamaican jerk seasoning.
Roast in the oven for 12-15 minutes or until tender.
While the asparagus is roasting, cook the fluffy in a medium saucepan with 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the fluffy is cooked and fluffy.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of fluffy in each bowl.
Top with roasted asparagus and serve immediately.
Optional: add any additional toppings you like, such as diced fruit or chopped nuts.
